target.title: fix(cron): channel failure alerts drop when global webhook failure destination is set
target.body:
Closes #102235

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators who set a job-level channel failure destination (for example `--failure-channel slack --failure-to #alerts` without `--failure-mode`) would never receive cron failure alerts when `cron.failureDestination` defaulted to a global webhook. The chat target was treated as a webhook URL, failed validation, and the failure notification was dropped with only a "webhook URL is invalid, skipping" log.

## Why This Change Was Made

`resolveFailureDestination` only reconciled `mode` when the job object included a `mode` field. A channel-shaped job override without `mode` therefore kept the inherited global webhook mode. This change treats a channel-shaped job failure destination without `mode` as announce (matching primary delivery defaults), clears an inherited webhook URL when mode switches, and leaves to-only overrides free to inherit a global webhook mode.

## User Impact

Cron failure alerts configured as channel/announce routes keep working even when a global webhook failure destination is also configured. Operators no longer lose job-level Slack/Telegram/etc. failure routes just because they omitted `--failure-mode`.

## Evidence

Focused resolver regressions for #102235 and inheritance siblings:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cron/delivery.test.ts
 ✓ |cron| src/cron/delivery.test.ts (22 tests)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cron/delivery.test.ts -t "#102235"
 ✓ 2 passed | 20 skipped

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cron/service/jobs.apply-patch.test.ts
 ✓ 9 passed

$ node scripts/test-projects.mjs --changed origin/main
 ✓ delivery.test.ts + delivery-plan.test.ts (24 tests)
```

Autoreview on branch vs `origin/main`: clean (no accepted/actionable findings).

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Job-level channel-shaped failure destinations without `mode` must not inherit a global webhook mode and silently drop channel failure alerts.
- Environment: macOS local checkout; Node via `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs`; branch `grok/cron-failure-dest-channel-mode` at `48e48fe210b09b7741866d3c2385307ef2f9fc95`.
- Current-main contrast: On main, `resolveFailureDestination` for job `{ channel: "slack", to: "#alerts" }` over global `{ mode: "webhook", to: "https://hook.example/cron" }` keeps `mode: "webhook"` and `to: "#alerts"`. The gateway failure dispatcher then hits `normalizeHttpWebhookUrl("#alerts")`, logs "cron: failure destination webhook URL is invalid, skipping", and does not announce to Slack.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cron/delivery.test.ts -t "#102235"`
  2. Asserts the reported shape resolves to announce/slack/#alerts and that a channel-only override clears the inherited webhook URL.
- Evidence after fix:
  ```text
  ✓ resolves a channel-shaped job override without mode to announce despite a global webhook default (#102235)
  ✓ clears an inherited global webhook URL when a channel-only override implies announce (#102235)
  Tests  2 passed | 20 skipped
  ```
- Control check: `keeps inheriting a global webhook mode for a to-only override without channel or mode` still expects `mode: "webhook"` with an overridden URL (to-only remains webhook-shaped inheritance).
- Observed result after fix: channel-shaped job destinations without mode resolve to `announce` with the job channel/target retained; global webhook defaults no longer poison those routes.
- What was not tested: live Slack/Telegram failure announce delivery end-to-end; full `pnpm check:changed` remote Crabbox/Testbox gate (local crabbox binary unavailable in this environment).

## AI disclosure

This fix was implemented with AI assistance (Grok). The behavior change and tests were verified locally against the reported resolver path; please review the inheritance edge cases before merge.
